requirements.rule: Art. 12 ter: the EUR 110 June element from 2020 is modelled for workers in service in June, in twelfths of the payment year and proportional to part-time hours, when EmployerProfile.second_level_premium is false. Not modelled: a company agreement paying less than EUR 110 must be topped up; no amount of that company payment is available to calculate the difference. The second-level premium flag does not distinguish agreements implementing art. 12 C from other company agreements.
requirements.remediation: Record the amount paid under a company agreement below EUR 110 and distinguish art. 12 C implementation before calculating the difference.

requirements.rule: Art. 12 bis: the elemento di garanzia retributiva is owed to the worker in service on 1 January and paid with the June pay; the text does not say whether a worker who leaves between January and June is paid it with the final settlement. The engine pays it only in the regular run of June.
requirements.remediation: Read an authoritative interpretation of art. 12 bis for a termination before June and settle the element there if owed.

requirements.rule: LEVEL 8 IDF: indennità di funzione 51.65 EUR modelled as fixed_allowance (unverified for period before Jan 2026). Function-conditional, not automatic for all L8 workers.
requirements.remediation: Gate IND_FUN by a role (function holders) and source the pre-Jan 2026 amount, or record the limitation.

requirements.rule: SUB-SECTORS (Art. 46 of the renewal 2024-2027 signed 18 February 2025, pp. 21-22; verbale of 21 February 2025, pp. 24-25): the calzature, giocattoli, occhiali and pelli e cuoio tables are modelled as the base_salary_by_subsector calzature, giocattoli, occhiali and pelli_cuoio (EmployerProfile.subsector), the occhiali and pelli e cuoio ones from the replacement tables of the verbale; level 4s exists only in the last three. Not modelled: the penne, spazzole e pennarelli table (pp. 22 and 24, with a 4S level). The levels the tables of giocattoli, occhiali and pelli e cuoio do not print (2bis, 3bis and 8; 7 also for occhiali and pelli e cuoio) are paid the tessile table when requested with those sub-sectors, and every level of the four sub-sectors takes the tessile seniority amounts.
requirements.remediation: Model the penne, spazzole e pennarelli table, source the seniority of the sub-sectors and reject the levels their tables lack, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2), which also excludes its cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day. A national CCNL rule that sets other hours to a day of leave prevails (art. 32 c. 1-bis): the run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL (work_rules.parental_hourly) or the rule sets its own hours, which the engine does not apply yet; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
